scope: All tracked and unignored project Markdown, including authored artifact narratives; verified per-file captured sources and generated failure contexts remain shared raw evidence. English mirrors are not source documents.
limits: Structural checks do not prove full semantic fidelity; independent sample review is separate.
Local file links are checked; renderer-specific anchors and remote availability are not guaranteed.
Translation preserves source-date claims; it is not new implementation, scientific evidence, legal approval or live-model validation.
